thread:
Chris: Quick sync — final asset lock + inbound playbook for the blog go-live tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need signoffs and HubSpot mapping confirmed by EOD.
Maya: Thanks — can we run a short checklist? I want hero, deck, CTAs, and benchmarks locked.
Chris: Yes. Checklist: hero image, deck (slide + excerpt), benchmark callouts (2), CTAs (demo/gated), form + thank-you path, webinar CTA + registration link.
Sophia: Hero is uploaded to drive v5_final.jpg. Minor color tweak pushed. Preview: https://drive.redwood.dev/hero/v5_preview.png
Leo: On inbound routing: plan is -> HubSpot form "redwood_launch_demo" -> workflow that tags "launch:webinar" and routes to SDR queue "growth-2". Will confirm mapping.
Jules: SDR queue capacity? we expect spikes from partners list — can we add overflow to growth-1?
Leo: Yep. Routing rule: primary growth-2, overflow growth-1 after 30m if unclaimed.
Maya: Webinar CTA placement? inline near benchmarks + bottom sticky CTA. Also add a modal after 45s with 1-click register.
Chris: Good. Make sure modal registers via the same HS form to keep properties consistent.
Nate: Legal quick check: benchmark claims need one-sentence methodology in parenthesis. Also avoid absolute language "cheaper than X" unless citation.
Sophia: Will add methodology microcopy under each benchmark: "(see benchmark appendix)".
Chris: @PublishBot — can we get a preview build of the post and the gated demo flow?
PublishBot: Preview published at https://staging.redwood.ai/blog/launch-preview-1729123456 — includes form flow and modal.
Maya: I pulled the preview. Modal fires correctly, form maps fields: email, company, use_case, demo_tier. Need to add "region" and "opt_in".
Leo: Adding region so SDRs can route by APAC/EU/NA. Will patch HS mapping now.
Chris: Paste HS mapping snippet here so Prod Ops can validate mappings.
Leo: ```
// HubSpot form mapping
email -> contact.email
company -> company.name
use_case -> contact.hs_use_case
demo_tier -> contact.hs_demo_tier
region -> contact.hs_region
opt_in -> contact.permissions_marketing
source -> "launch_blog"
```
Maya: Looks good. Can Prod Ops validate field types and dedupe rules?
Jules: On it. Will run a dry import and report duplicates by 30m.
Nate: One more legal: add GDPR consent checkbox text exact copy: "I consent to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference."
Sophia: Added checkbox and microcopy in the preview.
Chris: Signoff requests: Maya (content), Sophia (design), Nate (legal), Leo (growth routing), Jules (ops). Reply with :thumbsup: when ready.
Maya: :thumbsup: content final.
Sophia: :thumbsup: design ✅
Leo: :thumbsup: routing done, HS mapping patched.
Nate: :thumbsup: legal approved with microcopy.
Jules: Dry import done, no critical duplicates. Overflow queue set. :thumbsup:
Chris: Awesome — locking assets now. Final publish window set for 9:00 AM PT tomorrow. If any late changes, flag here and include diff + reason.
Maya: One tiny change: tweak the second benchmark language to be comparative but not absolute. I'll post the line edit in 10.
Chris: Ok — last call. Otherwise we ship.
Maya: Posted edit: "30–45% lower token cost vs. baseline inference in our internal tests (see appendix)."
Nate: Good wording.
Chris: All clear. Thanks team. :rocket:
